title: My AI plugin auto-published at 3 AM. Big mistake.

beats.speaker: me
beats.text: My AI plugin auto-published a blog post at 3 AM. It says our wedding cakes are free!
beats.tts: [panicking] My AI plugin auto-published a blog post at three AM. It says our wedding cakes are free!

beats.speaker: claude
beats.text: Did anyone read it before it went live?
beats.tts: [wincing] Did anyone read it before it went live?

beats.speaker: claude
beats.text: The robot isn't paying for those cakes.
beats.tts: [deadpan] The robot isn't paying for those cakes.

beats.speaker: claude
beats.text: This is why MyKavo never publishes for you.
beats.tts: [reassuring, then excited] This is why MyKavo never publishes for you.
beats.title: Meet MyKavo

beats.speaker: claude
beats.text: It writes the full post, then saves it to your WordPress drafts. You press publish, not a robot.
beats.tts: [confident] It writes the full post, then saves it to your WordPress drafts. You press publish. Not a robot.
beats.title: 1. Drafts, never auto-publish

beats.speaker: me
beats.text: But will it get my prices right?
beats.tts: [worried] But will it get my prices right?

beats.speaker: claude
beats.text: Review notes show which facts to check, and where your own experience goes.
beats.tts: [warm] Review notes show which facts to check... and where your own experience goes.
beats.title: 2. Review notes

beats.speaker: me
beats.text: And it knows what people actually search?
beats.tts: [curious] And it knows what people actually search?

beats.speaker: claude
beats.text: It finds searches you can win, like 'how much is a wedding cake'. Then checks page one before writing.
beats.tts: [energetic] It finds searches you can win, like 'how much is a wedding cake'. Then checks page one before writing.
beats.title: 3. Real search data

beats.speaker: claude
beats.text: One full post a month, free. The plugin's free too.
beats.tts: [casually] One full post a month, free. The plugin's free too.
beats.title: FREE plan

beats.speaker: me
beats.text: Free. Like my wedding cakes, apparently.
beats.tts: [dry, defeated] Free. Like my wedding cakes, apparently.
